statement: Re3 (2025) proposes a unified framework that dynamically balances semantic and temporal information through a query-aware gating mechanism for temporal information retrieval, achieving state-of-the-art results on temporal IR benchmarks.

evidence.quote: we propose Re3, a unified and lightweight framework that dynamically balances semantic and temporal information through a query-aware gating mechanism
On Re2Bench, Re3 achieves state-of-the-art results, leading in R@1 across all three subsets
